description: He wears an opaque teal crossed-front deel reaching below the knee. Tan-gold woven knot/cloud motifs decorate panels and borders at the opening, short outer sleeves and hem. Brown long under-sleeves show at the forearms with teal-and-gold patterned cuffs. A decorated brown sash and belt have round metal clasps and a long patterned tasseled end. Loose brown trousers tuck into dark brown calf-high leather boots with tan-gold shaft decoration. No headgear or weapon is visible.
